# githubtest

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/internal/github/githubtest"
```

Package githubtest is an in\-memory fake of the GitHub API endpoints the github package calls, for tests.

## type Issue

Issue is a stored issue.

```go
type Issue struct {
    Number   int
    Title    string
    Body     string
    State    string
    Labels   []string
    Comments []string
    // PR marks a pull request, which the issues list also returns.
    PR  bool

}
```

<a name="Server"></a>
## type Server

Server is the fake.

```go
type Server struct {
    *httptest.Server

    Owner  string
    Repo   string
    Token  string
    Issues []*Issue
    Labels map[string]bool
    // Org and ProjectNumber identify the one project; StatusOptions are its
    // Status options (name -> ID).
    Org           string
    ProjectNumber int
    StatusOptions map[string]string
    Items         []ProjectItem
    // FailPaths makes requests whose "METHOD path" or "METHOD path?query"
    // starts with a key fail with that status.
    FailPaths map[string]int
    // GraphQLError, if set, is returned as a GraphQL error for every query.
    GraphQLError string
    // Requests logs "METHOD path" of every request.
    Requests []string
    // PerPage overrides the page size the fake uses for issue lists (the
    // client always asks for 100); 0 keeps the request's per_page.
    PerPage int

    // Release data; see release.go.
    Tags            []Tag
    Compares        map[string][]Commit // "base...head" -> commits, oldest first
    RefCommits      map[string][]Commit // ref -> commits, newest first
    Releases        map[string]Release  // tag -> published release
    Milestones      []*Milestone
    Pulls           []Pull
    PullFiles       map[int][]github.PullFile // pull request number -> changed files
    Branches        map[string]string         // branch -> commit
    Files           map[string]string         // path -> file content (GET /contents)
    Merges          []Merge                   // server-side merges, in order
    CommitsOnBranch []CommitOnBranch          // GraphQL createCommitOnBranch, in order
    WorkflowRuns    []WorkflowRun             // Actions runs, newest first
    // Login is the author of issues created through the API (the App\'s bot).
    Login string
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```
